gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-batak: Amatic SC draws quirky, rustic letters in a single squeezed line, with round bowls and terminals that stop well short of the stem. Noto Sans Batak sits beneath it as a sans with a towering x-height and a wide-open e.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Quirky and rustic up top, Amatic SC runs a tube-like stroke that holds its thickness through every bend, set against Noto Sans Bengali. Handwritten against sans-serif is the whole story.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads as plain sans, its lowercase swollen like tightly coiled rope with apertures that stay easy to read. Amatic SC, drawn like bent wire, earns its keep when big and short.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Noto Sans Buginese has open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs, short ascenders, and a modern, plain sans manner. And Amatic SC, drawn with the line weight of a technical pen, gives it a handwritten counterpart.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Rustic and a bit quirky, Amatic SC writes with a pencil-line consistency. Noto Sans Buhid answers in a modern sans with generous space between curve ends and stems, plus a high-set x-height; handwriting against structure is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-carian: Noto Sans Carian reads as clean sans-serif, its terminals staying apart like open scissor blades beneath a heading whose thickness never shifts with direction. Amatic SC supplies that handwritten line.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Amatic SC writes in a rounded-wire stroke, rustic and quirky, with terminals that stop far from the stem. But Noto Sans Chakma, a sans-serif with lowercase packed toward the caps and uncrowded s and c mouths, steadies it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-cham: Diagonals that match the stems give Amatic SC its rustic, quirky, handwritten look. Noto Sans Cham follows as a modern sans with tall rounded lowercase, open entries, and a clean, easy flow over long paragraphs.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee forms a tall band of letters with short stalks above and a wide gap at the e's terminal, under Amatic SC's quirky handwriting. They feel like a sketchbook beside a printed sheet.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Scribbled and sunny, Amatic SC has no pressure swells where the eye slows down, so its rustic line runs freely above Noto Sans Chorasmian. Handwriting against a large-x-height sans-serif is the whole charm.
